title: IFC Topic (/ifc/*) Schema
description: Generalized schema for entities published on the /ifc/* topics (e.g. /ifc/wall, /ifc/space, /ifc/mep_elements). Each topic carries a named collection of entities; every entity has its own attributes and a list of typed relationships to other entities.

additionalProperties.description: A collection of entities of one kind, keyed by the topic name (e.g. "walls", "spaces", "mep_elements").

entity.description: A scene-graph node. Carries identity, an open set of attributes, and outgoing relationships to other entities.

id.description: Stable unique identifier (e.g. the IFC GlobalId).

attributes.description: Open set of entity-specific properties (geometry, materials, custom fields). Shape depends on the entity type.

relationship.description: A typed, directed edge from this entity to a target entity, referenced by its identity.

id.description: id of the target entity this edge points to.

name.description: Human-readable label of the target entity.
